parts.script:
Anna: Hey, Matt! Are you free this weekend? I was thinking we could go on a little weekend getaway. What do you think?  
Matt: That sounds great! Where do you want to go?  
Anna: I was thinking we could head to the lake. It’s only a couple of hours away.  
Matt: Nice! Do you want to drive there?  
Anna: Yeah, I can drive. We can leave early Saturday morning.  
Matt: Perfect! Should we pack food for the trip?  
Anna: Definitely! I’ll bring sandwiches and some snacks. How about drinks?  
Matt: I can take care of the drinks. Maybe some water and soda?  
Anna: Sounds good. And we should also bring a few games for the evening.  
Matt: Right, I have a card game we can play!  
Anna: Awesome! Should we invite Sarah too?  
Matt: Yeah, she loves outdoor activities!  
Anna: Okay, I’ll text her and see if she can join us.  
Matt: Great! I can’t wait for the weekend!  
Anna: Me too! It’s going to be a lot of fun.
